meta.description: All spells for TDE4/DSA4.1. Includes Basic Rules spells and full Liber Cantiones expansion.

spells.name: Abvenenum
spells.description: Purifies food and drink from all poisons and disease pathogens. The Arcane Test is penalized by twice the poison level.

spells.name: Eye of Eagle, Ear of Lynx
spells.description: All of the caster's senses are greatly increased, giving a Difficulty Decrease equal to SP* on all Perception Tests.

spells.name: Adlerschwinge
spells.description: Grants the caster limited flying ability based on SP*.

spells.name: Analytica Arcana
spells.description: The caster discovers the type and origin of a spell found in an item or on a person. Depending on SP*, the information may be more or less accurate.

spells.name: Fastness of Body
spells.description: Creates an invisible set of armor which does not encumber, to a maximum Armor Rating equaling SP.

spells.name: Attributio
spells.description: The caster increases one Attribute Value by 2 points for the spell's duration. The subject may be the caster or another individual.

spells.name: Auris Nasis Oculus
spells.description: Creates illusory sounds, smells, and three-dimensional (but stationary) images of up to 30 cubic paces in size.

spells.name: Move as the Lightning
spells.description: Increases the recipient's speed tremendously. Grants +2 AT and PA, doubles Speed and Base Initiative, and doubles Athletics TP for running and jumping.

spells.name: Balm of Healing
spells.description: For each ASP invested, the target immediately regenerates 1 VP. A caster may heal herself for no more than SP x 2 VP. For every 7 ASP spent, one wound may be healed completely.

spells.name: Be My Friend
spells.description: The caster charms her target into believing that the caster is his best friend. The target answers all questions truthfully and follows all suggestions unless they endanger his life or moral integrity.

spells.name: Beherrschung brechen
spells.description: Breaks a domination or compulsion spell currently affecting the target.

spells.name: See True and Pure
spells.description: Allows the caster to divine the target's feelings and moods, identifying basic emotions such as hostility. Does not work on emotionless creatures, undead, demons, or animals.

spells.name: Breath of Magic
spells.description: Lets the caster detect traces of active magic on a person, item, or any currently active magical force. Caster perceives a reddish glow if magic is detected.

spells.name: Claudibus Clavistibor
spells.description: Locks a door, chest lid, or similar locking device by means of magic and increases the material's hardness. Only high Dexterity, brute force, or magic can prevail against the magical lock.

spells.name: Duplicatus
spells.description: Creates one or two illusory doubles of the caster which mimic her movements. For any successful Attack, roll 1d6: on 1-3 the caster is hit; otherwise the double is hit.

spells.name: Einfluss bannen
spells.description: Removes a domination or influence spell currently affecting the target.

spells.name: Exposami
spells.description: Reveals invisible beings and hidden or concealed objects in the area of effect.

spells.name: Elfenstimme
spells.description: The elf's voice becomes magically beautiful and compelling. Grants substantial bonuses to social interactions.

spells.name: Falcon Eye
spells.description: Greatly sharpens the caster's eyesight, allowing her to see clearly at great distances.

spells.name: Flim Flam Funkel
spells.description: Conjures a small ball of light with a bluish-white glow, about as bright as a torch, hovering over the caster's hand. Burns cold and does not ignite objects.

spells.name: Foramen Foraminor
spells.description: Opens mechanical locks, bolts, and other fasteners on doors, chests, and similar items. The caster needs no knowledge of the locking mechanism.

spells.name: Thunderbolt
spells.description: Conjures an invisible magical strike that bypasses any normal armor. Damage is 2d6 + SP*. All DP are subtracted directly from the target's Vitality.

spells.name: Gardianum
spells.asp_cost: ASP invested + CO + SP* HP blocked
spells.description: Creates an invisible dome-shaped shield that absorbs all raw magical damage (HP/DP from direct magical attacks). Does not protect from normal weapons, transformation, or domination spells.

spells.name: Gedankenbilder
spells.description: Projects images from the caster's mind, allowing her to show others her mental images or visions.

spells.name: Horriphobus
spells.description: The target loses heart, either running away screaming or cowering in primal fear. Works against thinking/feeling creatures; not against slime, insects, undead or demons. Can target multiple creatures.

spells.name: Ignifaxus
spells.description: A ray of elemental fire shoots from the caster's fingers. The caster chooses how many d6 of damage (up to SP). For each 10 HP inflicted, the target loses 1 AR.

spells.name: Clarum Purum
spells.description: Stops the effects of poison coursing through a person's veins. Prevents further damage but does not regenerate lost VP.

spells.name: Movimento
spells.description: Telekinetically moves inanimate objects without touching them.

spells.name: Fog Flow Far
spells.description: Creates an absolutely opaque cloud of mist shaped as the caster decides. Volume is SP* x 20 in square paces.

spells.name: Breath of Magic
spells.description: Detects traces of active magic on a person, item, or any currently active magical force. Caster perceives a reddish glow if magic is present.

spells.name: Paralyze
spells.asp_cost: 13 per target (11 per target if multiple)
spells.description: Magically immobilizes one or more opponents, turning them into a diamond-hard substance. Targets cannot move but cannot be harmed by normal weapons, fire, or similar damage.

spells.name: Penetration
spells.description: The caster may see through obstacles as if she were on the other side of the barrier. While penetrating, she can do nothing else.

spells.name: Spiritus Armoricus
spells.description: Strengthens the recipient's self-esteem and inner body-soul connection, increasing RM by SP* (by SP* x 1.5 against farsight spells).

spells.name: Mutander Salother
spells.description: Turns a living creature into another living creature or plant of smaller size. Three durations available at different ASP costs.

spells.name: Gentle Disposition
spells.description: Calms an aggressive creature, reducing its hostility and making it peaceful.

spells.name: Silver Tongue
spells.description: Greatly enhances the caster's social abilities and powers of persuasion.

spells.name: Sensibar
spells.description: Allows the caster to divine the target's feelings and moods.

spells.name: Silence Reigns Supreme
spells.description: Creates a spherical zone in which air no longer carries sound waves. Zone may move with the caster.

spells.name: Sleep of a Thousand Sheep
spells.description: Puts one or more living creatures to sleep. Target awakens immediately if attacked or shaken. Target must be stationary prior to casting.

spells.name: Leave No Trace
spells.description: The caster and companions leave no tracks and make no sound while moving.

spells.name: Animal Thoughts
spells.description: Allows the caster to sense the thoughts and emotions of animals.

spells.name: Unseen
spells.description: The caster becomes completely invisible. Works only on living creatures. Invisible creatures can still be perceived by other senses (smell, touch).

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater as easily as air.

spells.name: White Mane
spells.description: Summons or binds a unicorn. One of the rare elfic rituals dealing with pure creatures.

spells.name: Magic Sustenance
spells.description: Creates magically sustaining food that provides complete nourishment without normal eating.
